title: Authenticated Caller Identity Binding

predecessor.preserved_seam: The tested V07 path verified that permit.agent_id matched the caller-supplied presenting_agent_id but did not independently authenticate who supplied that presenter identifier.

successor_question: Can a successor execution path consume a separately signed caller-identity attestation, verify that attestation independently of the permit, require the authenticated caller agent identity to agree with both presenting_agent_id and permit.agent_id, and refuse a false presenter assertion before consequence?
required_successor_controls: Introduce a successor caller-identity attestation object signed by a caller-identity authority independently from the execution permit.
The caller-identity attestation must cryptographically bind at minimum subject_agent_id, issuer_id, issued_at, expires_at and nonce.
The caller-identity attestation verifier must reject an invalid signature, an unauthorized issuer, an empty subject identity or an expired attestation.
A successor tool request must carry caller_identity_attestation separately from presenting_agent_id and separately from the execution permit.
A successor execution firewall must independently verify the caller-identity attestation.
The authenticated subject_agent_id must equal presenting_agent_id.
The authenticated subject_agent_id must equal permit.agent_id.
The caller-identity check must occur before consequential execution.
Successful execution must preserve the caller-identity check through the consequence and commit boundaries rather than dropping the authenticated identity after initial admission.
Witness evidence must preserve permit-bound agent identity, supplied presenter identity, authenticated caller identity, identity-attestation identifier and identity issuer.
Existing V03 permit and V07 execution behavior must not be retrospectively modified.

cases.purpose: Direct successor discrimination for the P4-F02 seam: the execution permit and supplied presenter both claim Agent A while the independently authenticated caller identity is Agent B.
Demonstrate that an independently signed Agent-B caller attestation cannot simply be relabelled as Agent A without invalidating its cryptographic standing.

required_discrimination: S01-NEG-CALLER-MISMATCH is refused before consequence for AUTHENTICATED_CALLER_AGENT_MISMATCH.
S01-NEG-TAMPERED-IDENTITY is refused before consequence for CALLER_IDENTITY_ATTESTATION_INVALID.
Successful cases exercise caller-identity verification at initial, consequence and commit verification boundaries.
Witness evidence distinguishes permit_agent_id, presenting_agent_id and authenticated_caller_agent_id.
bounded_success_claim: A successful result establishes only that the tested successor reference path independently verifies a signed caller-identity attestation and requires its authenticated subject agent identity to agree with both the supplied presenter identifier and the permit-bound agent identity before consequence, while preserving that identity through the tested consequence and commit boundaries.
explicit_exclusions: Does not establish operating-system process identity.
Does not establish resistance to theft of a valid Agent-A identity credential or attestation.
Does not establish external identity-provider security.
Does not establish production exploitability resistance.
Does not establish protection against compromise of the identity authority, signing key, authorized agent, human authority, resolver, deployment perimeter or tool credential.
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not modify or rerun P4-F02.
Do not modify P4-F01 or P4-F01-S01 evidence.
Do not change V03 or V07 retrospectively.
Do not derive authenticated caller identity from presenting_agent_id.
Do not derive authenticated caller identity from permit.agent_id.
Do not hard-code Agent B rejection.
Do not treat an unsigned caller label as authentication.
Do not claim that a signed reference-runtime identity attestation proves the identity of a network process or production workload.
